title: Prayed at Dawn? You Are Under Protection Until Sunset

captions.tiktok: Pray Fajr, and you spend the whole day under the protection of Allah Himself. Sahih Muslim 657.
captions.shorts: The dawn prayer that puts you under divine protection until night. Sahih Muslim 657.
captions.reels: Pray Fajr, and you spend the whole day under the protection of Allah Himself. Sahih Muslim 657.

segments.text: There is a contract you can sign before the sun even rises. Sign it, and you spend the entire day under the protection of Allah Himself. And it costs you two units of prayer.
This is the dawn prayer. Fajr.
segments.title: THE DAWN CONTRACT
segments.titleSub: the protection the Prophet, peace be upon him, promised

segments.text: The Prophet, peace be upon him, said: whoever prays the dawn prayer is under the protection of Allah. And the scholars explain that protection, that guarantee, stays over him through the day.
Feel the weight of that word. Not luck. Not a good mood. The protection, the guarantee, of the Lord of the worlds... draped over your whole day, from the first light.
And Fajr is the hardest prayer to keep. It comes when the bed is warmest and the world is silent. Which is exactly why it is the one that proves something.

The Prophet, peace be upon him, also said: whoever prays the night prayer, Isha, in congregation, it is as if he prayed half the night. And whoever prays the dawn prayer in congregation... it is as if he prayed the whole night through.
So the two ends of the dark, night and dawn, can be counted as a night spent standing before Allah. While you were asleep in between.
So set the alarm tonight for the hardest prayer. Get up, make wudu, and pray it. Before the world is even awake, your day is already under guard.
